fn gcd(m: Int, n: Int) -> Int
  requires (m >= 0)
  requires (n >= 0)
  requires (m > 0)
  requires (n > 0)
  ensures (result == (if (m == n) then m else if (m > n) then gcd((m - n), n) else gcd(m, (n - m))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (gcd(1, 1) == 1)
  example (gcd(2, 2) == 2)
{
  if (m == n) then m else if (m > n) then gcd((m - n), n) else gcd(m, (n - m))
}

fn gcdI(m: Int, n: Int) -> Int
  requires (m > 0)
  requires (n > 0)
  ensures (result == gcd(m, n))
  effects pure
  example (gcdI(0, 0) == 0)
{
  0
}
